Hi Amir — thanks for reaching out and great to hear HealthSync is ready to move forward.

Quick heads-up: Redwood has an all-hands engineering offsite and company-wide support coverage freeze between Nov 29–Dec 1 this year. Our engineers and some sales/solutions staff will be at the offsite, so Nov 30 is unfortunately inside that blackout for deep technical demos.

Options I can offer right now:
- Move to the week of Dec 6 (we have full engineering coverage Dec 7–9).
- Do a lighter, product-overview + security roadmap session on Nov 30 at the time you suggested (no live Q&A on infra/config; will be led by Solutions AE).
- Keep Nov 30 and mark the session as "at-risk" with an immediate fallback to Dec 7 if we hit an emergency.

If you prefer a solution that requires an engineer on the call (recommended for the GC/IT review), I suggest Dec 8 at 10:00am PST. I'm looping in Ben to see if he can support an on-call demo coverage option.

Apologies for the inconvenience — want to make sure we set the right expectation for the technical review.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147
